purpose: A named placeholder for an AI response that has not yet produced readable content.
behaviorProvider: Status region with decorative placeholder lines.

component: Expose a status region with the supplied label and an equivalent visually hidden text label. All placeholder lines are aria-hidden.
Normalize finite line counts to whole values between one and twelve and use three for non-finite input. variant controls text/card presentation.
host: Mount only during actual pending generation and replace with result/error content when the host operation completes.
Avoid redundant live announcements when composing with other loading feedback; preserve reduced-motion styling.

requirements.statement: Expose a status region with the supplied label and an equivalent visually hidden text label. All placeholder lines are aria-hidden.
Normalize finite line counts to whole values between one and twelve and use three for non-finite input. variant controls text/card presentation.
Mount only during actual pending generation and replace with result/error content when the host operation completes.
Avoid redundant live announcements when composing with other loading feedback; preserve reduced-motion styling.

Use ai group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Placeholder count does not estimate response length or progress; no stream lifecycle is implemented.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
